Downtown Sarasota Black Friday and Shop.verification: Wikimedia Commons file "Sarasota FL Downtown HD01.jpg" by Ebyabe, taken 2011-06-19, categorised Downtown Sarasota Historic District. Live Commons licence checked 2026-11-23: CC BY-SA 3.0. Viewed the original 4288x3216 photograph: a tree-lined commercial street of shop fronts, awnings, and parked cars in downtown Sarasota. A Cinco de Mayo banner on a shop at the right of the original frame was cropped out so the pick does not show the wrong season. The crop is still the same downtown shopping street, captioned as the place and not as Black Friday or Shop Small Saturday.
